授業概要
建築分野で消費されるエネルギー消費量は日本のエネルギー消費量全体の約１／３を占める。持続型社会の形成のために、建築分野が果たすべき役割は大きい。持続型社会の実現に向けて建築関連技術者が取り組むべき課題について情報収集と議論を繰り返しながら、解決策の提言を行う。
Much energy consumed in architectural field in the world.
The role that an architectural specialist should play for is very important to form the sustainable society.
In this lecture, we discuss about what we should do for sustainable society, and we propose solutions.

全体の教育目標
To acquire ability to gather necessary statistical data for sustainable society by oneself.
To acquire ability to analyze them and propose solutions from the view point of a specialist.
個別の教育目標
To acquire ability to shape the ideal architecture for sustainable society.
To acquire ability to have wide knowledge and put them to practical use.
授業計画
1.extraction of problem
2.Collection of statistical information etc. and discussion
3.Proposal of solution based on analysis
4.Grasp of effect of solution
5.Final proposal
